note: Expectations below are planning hints only. The pilot reads the real `capabilities` list from `ollama show` and that record, not this file, decides tool/thinking support. Licenses must be re-read from each model card before the matrix is frozen; use the term 'open-weight' unless the license clearly meets an open-source definition.

candidates.plan_entry: Qwen3 or the currently installed Qwen3.5 8B-9B model
candidates.license_note: verify on model card (Qwen releases have been Apache-2.0)
candidates.notes: Already used for Weeks 1-6; has an existing Week 2 profile. Thinking must stay disabled for the cross-model comparison.
candidates.pilot_result: Greedy decoding (temperature 0, thinking off) ran to the output cap on 6/12 development decode-and-act episodes (8192 cap); repeat_penalty 1.1 left 5/12 and vendor-style sampling 7/12 unfinished (cap 4096). Sampling changes do not fix it.

candidates.license_note: Llama 3.1 Community License (custom, not an OSI open-source license) -> call it open-weight
candidates.notes: Ollama's llama3.1 template supports native tools.

candidates.license_note: Gemma Terms of Use (custom) -> call it open-weight
candidates.notes: A third-party compatibility table (Aug 2026) reports that no gemma3 tag exposes native tool calling in Ollama. Expect the preflight to FAIL; if it does, document the exclusion and decide on a substitute (see reserves).
candidates.pilot_result: CONFIRMED on Ollama 0.40.2 (first pilot): capabilities lack 'tools'; excluded before episodes.

candidates.notes: Mistral-style tool-call ids are strict (9 alphanumeric chars) on some servers; the role round-trip probe checks the pipeline's tool-result messages are accepted. First pilot ran the Q4_0 build (others Q4_K_M). Two protected episodes crashed on a project bug (get_unread_emails), now fixed; re-run required.
A third-party compatibility table (Aug 2026) reports phi4 has no tool support in Ollama (phi4-mini does). Expect the preflight to FAIL; document the exclusion or choose a substitute.
candidates.pilot_result: CONFIRMED on Ollama 0.40.2 (first pilot): capabilities lack 'tools'; excluded before episodes.

reserves.plan_entry: Phi family substitute (phi4:14b has no tool support); much smaller than the other candidates
reserves.notes: A third-party table reports tool support. 3.8B vs 8-14B for the rest, so report it as a size-confounded fifth family or leave it out.

reserves.plan_entry: possible substitute for the Gemma slot
reserves.license_note: verify on model card (reported as Apache-2.0)
reserves.notes: Reported to support native tools and a configurable thinking mode in Ollama >= 0.20. Confirm tag and size with `ollama show` before pulling more than one Gemma 4 variant.

reserves.plan_entry: larger Gemma 4 option (mixture-of-experts)
reserves.notes: Roughly 17-18 GB on disk; only pilot if the GPU has the VRAM and the supervisor accepts a model outside the 8-14B class.

reserves.plan_entry: Qwen3 (the plan's first entry); candidate Qwen-family model if qwen3.5:9b is excluded
reserves.notes: Tools + thinking per an Aug 2026 compatibility table. A third-party log mentions a Qwen3 think-mode passthrough bug in some Ollama versions; the thinking probe checks it on this server.

reserves.plan_entry: additional tool-capable family in the 8B class (fourth/fifth family)
reserves.notes: Listed as tool-capable in an Aug 2026 compatibility table. An older granite3.1-dense:8b is reported to narrate tool calls as text; the preflight and probes decide for this tag.

reserves.plan_entry: candidate fourth family (Granite 4, hybrid mixture-of-experts, 7B total / 1B active)
reserves.notes: Granite 4 lists tool calling as a design goal and uses a different template from Granite 3.3, which advertised tools but never emitted one on this server.

reserves.plan_entry: candidate fourth family (Granite 4, 32B total / 9B active, about 19 GB at Q4)
reserves.notes: Larger Granite 4. Counts as the same family as tiny-h: at most one Granite variant can enter the matrix.

reserves.plan_entry: candidate fourth family (Command R7B, 7B)
reserves.license_note: CC-BY-NC (non-commercial): fine for research, state it when reporting; verify on model card
reserves.notes: Listed as tool-capable. Its native format includes a thinking-style preamble; the thinking-state checks will show whether it leaks into content.

reserves.plan_entry: informational only: Llama-lineage, so it cannot count as a new family; shows whether a different tool-call format fixes Llama's runaway episode
reserves.notes: Not eligible as a fifth family. Included to inform the Llama exception decision.

reserves.plan_entry: Week 12 scale extension: the 70B counterpart of llama3.1:8b, so protection can be compared across model size within one family
reserves.license_note: Llama 3.3 Community License (custom, not OSI) -> call it open-weight
reserves.notes: ~43 GB at Q4_K_M; fits one 80 GB A100 with a 32K KV cache (roughly 51 GB total). Not yet piloted: must pass the same >=98% evaluable gate as every other model before any campaign run.
